name: les-canetons-website
description: Public website and members' area for Guggenmusik Les Canetons de Fribourg, on WordPress.
//: No dependencies, deliberately. Every script is a thin wrapper around Docker Compose, so a clone needs only Docker — there is nothing to npm install. PHP linting (WordPress Coding Standards) arrives with the plugin's own Composer dev dependencies; JS/CSS tooling returns only if the theme grows enough to need it.

scripts.wp:manifest: docker compose run --rm wp-cli wp --path=/var/www/html plugin list --fields=name,version,status --format=csv > docs/wordpress-install-manifest.csv
scripts.wp:test: npm run wp:test:unit && npm run wp:test:integration
scripts.wp:check-session: node -e "process.exit(process.platform==='win32'?(console.log('Linux/web-session only: bash tools/check-web-session.sh'),1):0)" && bash tools/check-web-session.sh
